question: Which of the following extensions is used to save MS - PowerPoint applications?
solution:
The correct answer is __**.ppt**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **.ppt** is the file extension used for saving Microsoft PowerPoint presentations.
 
• Microsoft PowerPoint is a widely used program for creating and displaying presentations.
 
• Other file extensions related to PowerPoint include **.pptx**, which is used by newer versions of the software.
 
• Extensions like **.txt, .doc, and .docx** are associated with plain text files and Microsoft Word documents, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Microsoft PowerPoint was developed by **Robert Gaskins and Dennis Austin** at a software company named Forethought, Inc.
 
• It was released on **April 20, 1987**, initially for Macintosh computers only.
 
• Microsoft acquired PowerPoint for **$14 million** three months after its release.
 
• Since then, PowerPoint has become an integral part of the Microsoft Office Suite.
 
• PowerPoint presentations can include text, images, videos, animations, and other multimedia elements.
